title: NASA-style governance methods & principles, mapped to Hs practice
author: Peter Higgins (human authorship for claims); AI-assisted per HUF-STD-001 (Claude Fable 5)
honest_scope: Hs is NOT NASA-certified and claims no flight heritage. This adopts NASA-STYLE governance as a self-imposed discipline. Flight/space-readiness framing is Tier 3 (aspiration).

crosswalk.hs: HGS-000..008 Pre-Phase-A suite; CCTT 7-phase with 2 operator gates; push protocol green-CI gate
Peter = sole commit/contact (programmatic); frozen oracle = engineering authority; honest-broker + claim tiers = mission assurance
frozen-oracle parity; engine self-test (BIST); HUF AI Collective cross-checks; open cross-platform reproduction challenge
internal-vs-external shock classifier + channel isolation; SELF_DIAGNOSTICS_AND_LIFECYCLE; E-21 carrier guard
hash-chained provenance (cntt_content_sha256); version triple; frozen oracle; push/CHANGELOG/PUSHES_INDEX chain
Safe Operations Doctrine (hold-and-report); DX-NUL-DIS null flag; L3-DSJ-ERR refuse-to-guess
Open-Loop / Skydiver Doctrine: engine emits diagnostics + codes, never an action
Kill-Test Doctrine: non-proportional data, degenerate carriers/E-21, broken closure documented as confirmed kills
Composition Monitoring (MC-4): the 4th monitoring category; ratio blindness closed
claim tiers; nulls reported straight; Investigation Catalog keeps falsified branches on record
SPACE_READINESS_AND_CHALLENGE.md deterministic twin study (engine adds zero variance)

lifecycle_in_hs_terms.PrePhaseA_concept: flight spec suite (HGS-000..008), feasibility studies, candidate/frontier roadmap. Gate: survive the kill-test.
lifecycle_in_hs_terms.PhaseAB_definition: domain study on real data with a named expert (geology-wehner, microbiome). Gate: CCTT-2 adapter-select.
lifecycle_in_hs_terms.PhaseCD_build_verify: engine run + self-test + frozen-oracle parity + figures + writeup. Gate: CCTT-6 self-verify + green CI.
lifecycle_in_hs_terms.PhaseE_operate: deterministic instrument in use; FDIR running; operator decides. Gate: the open loop.
